items.title: The Library Return Cart
items.topic: students improving a cart used to return books to school library shelves
items.action: sorted returned books by shelf area before moving the cart
items.benefit: books reached the correct shelves faster and students could find them again sooner
items.challenge: some labels were faded and difficult to read
items.lesson: a simple system works best when its signs remain clear
items.detail: the team replaced old labels with larger printed cards
items.reflection: Mio learned that small improvements can save time for many people
items.topicJa: 学校図書館で返却本を棚へ戻すカートを生徒が改善する活動
items.benefitJa: 本をより早く正しい棚へ戻し再び探しやすくできること
items.challengeJa: 一部のラベルが薄れて読みにくくなっていたこと
items.lessonJa: 簡単な仕組みでも表示を分かりやすく保つことが大切

items.title: Morning Water Station
items.topic: a school club setting up a drinking water station before summer practice
items.action: prepared refill jugs and marked a shaded place for bottles
items.benefit: students could refill water easily during hot practice sessions
items.challenge: the water warmed quickly when containers stood in direct sunlight
items.lesson: good preparation includes thinking about where supplies are kept
items.detail: the club moved the station beneath a covered walkway
items.reflection: Yuta learned that location can matter as much as the supplies themselves
items.titleJa: 朝の給水ステーション
items.topicJa: 夏の部活動前に給水場所を準備する学校の取り組み
items.benefitJa: 暑い練習中でも生徒が簡単に水を補給できること
items.challengeJa: 容器を直射日光に置くと水がすぐ温かくなること
items.lessonJa: 準備では物を用意するだけでなく置く場所も考える必要がある

items.title: The Quiet Lunch Corner
items.topic: students creating a quieter lunch space for classmates who preferred less noise
items.place: an unused corner beside the school hall
items.action: arranged a few tables and posted simple rules about quiet conversation
items.benefit: students who felt tired by loud rooms had another place to eat
items.challenge: the space became crowded on rainy days
items.lesson: a helpful idea needs a plan for times when demand suddenly grows
items.detail: teachers opened a nearby room when all seats were filled
items.reflection: Aoi learned that flexible plans can keep a small service useful
items.topicJa: にぎやかな場所が苦手な生徒向けに静かな昼食場所を作る活動
items.benefitJa: 大きな音で疲れる生徒が別の場所で食事できること
items.challengeJa: 雨の日には利用者が増えて混雑したこと
items.lessonJa: 利用が急に増える場合も考えて柔軟な計画を用意することが大切

items.title: A Map for New Students
items.topic: students making a simple school map for classmates who had just transferred
items.place: a large junior high school building
items.action: walked through the building and marked rooms that new students often needed
items.benefit: new students could reach offices and special classrooms with less confusion
items.challenge: some room names were different from the words students used in daily conversation
items.lesson: instructions are easier to follow when they use familiar language
items.detail: the map included both official room names and common nicknames
items.reflection: Riku learned to test information from the viewpoint of the person who will use it
items.titleJa: 転入生のための校内地図
items.topicJa: 転入したばかりの生徒向けに分かりやすい校内地図を作る活動
items.benefitJa: 職員室や特別教室へ迷わず行きやすくなること
items.challengeJa: 正式な教室名と普段使われる呼び名が異なる場合があったこと
items.lessonJa: 案内は利用者になじみのある言葉を使うと分かりやすくなる
